neighbours.label: the piece ending a word split before a stressed syllable: -ard of Edouard, -od of daffodil, -uta of Battuta, -ad of Dybwad
fire: The critic wrote about Edouard Vuillard last year.
We planted daffodils along the fence.
The travels of Ibn Battuta fill the book.
She thanked Dybwad for the note.
Edouard was the painter's first name.
Yellow daffodils came up in March.
Students read Battuta in the first term.
An email from Dybwad arrived today.
quiet: The critic wrote about Pierre Bonnard last year.
We planted tulips along the fence.
The travels of Marco Polo fill the book.
She thanked Smith for the note.
Pierre was the painter's first name.
Yellow tulips came up in March.
Students read Homer in the first term.
An email from Smith arrived today.

notes: A list from the card's top pieces, not a shared pattern; 'stressed syllable' is my guess. 'Bonnard' in a near miss splits as ' Bon' + 'nard', so it does not contain the piece 'ard'.
